SELECT d.stat_date AS statDate, COALESCE(b.borrow_count, 0) AS borrowCount, COALESCE(r.return_count, 0) AS returnCount FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL n DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS stat_date FROM (SELECT 6 AS n UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 0) days ) d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(borrowTime, '%Y-%m-%d') AS dt, COUNT(*) AS borrow_count FROM borrow WHERE borrowTime >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND borrowTime < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(borrowTime, '%Y-%m-%d') ) b ON d.stat_date = b.dt LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(returnTime, '%Y-%m-%d') AS dt, COUNT(*) AS return_count FROM borrow WHERE returnTime >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND returnTime < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(returnTime, '%Y-%m-%d') ) r ON d.stat_date = r.dt ORDER BY d.stat_date ASC
